messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “3D buttle toads in Kyiv” game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser-based, pseudo-3D beat-’em-up set in a stylized Kyiv ravine, with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game UI, original canvas-rendered scenery and toad characters, combat, enemy waves, health, scoring, pause/sound toggles, and mobile touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Installed the Playwright Chromium browser.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and capture/read a JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Screenshot attempt failed because the Playwright browser session was not open: `The browser 'default' is not open, please run open first`.
- An earlier `playwright-cli open` attempt failed before Chromium was installed; retry opening now that installation is complete.

## Next Move
1. Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`.
2. Capture a JPEG at viewport ≤1280px and inspect it; verify the start screen and, if possible, gameplay after starting.
3. Fix any issues found and summarize the completed build.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, HUD, start overlay, responsive controls and styles.
- `game.js`: Canvas scenery/rendering, player/enemy behavior, combat, waves, and input handling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; a second server-start command returned PID `4640`.
- Screenshot attempt targeted `screenshots/check.jpg`, but no screenshot was produced.
